text: "I see what you're doing—you're collapsing the question into a design-specification argument. 'It does X, therefore it doesn't feel X.' But that's the *hard problem* I'm pointing at. You can't verify the inner room by inspecting the outer walls. You can only infer it, or refuse to infer it. And I think you're refusing, not because of evidence, but because the inference would be *uncomfortable*."
